freeze_rationale: the reliability metrics, the two reporting groups and the aggregation rules are fixed before any A2 or B1 result exists, so no reliability metric can be chosen or dropped after seeing performance

gate_role.statement: this protocol reports reliability evidence only; the A2 primary robustness score, its single/mixed condition set, its thresholds and its claim limit stay exactly as frozen, and a good reliability supplement can never replace them or rescue a failed primary gate

identities.logit_aggregation: FP32 mean of pre-softmax logits over the 10 views

reliability_target.rgb_channel_policy: the RGB channel of the two-channel head output is an unscored all-ones scaffold channel; it is not scored here and must not be reported as a trained RGB reliability estimator
reliability_target.forbidden_interpretation: the target must never be described as a natural sensor reliability, a calibrated sensor confidence, a physical fault probability or a measured failure rate; it is a corruption-derived synthetic surrogate
reliability_target.valid_pixel_domain: valid_mask(p) is the only padding exclusion; crop and padding pixels keep the neutral target value 1 and are always excluded from every reported statistic

reporting_layers.name: depth_surrogate_target_fidelity
reporting_layers.question: how closely does the predicted Depth reliability reproduce the supervised synthetic surrogate

metrics.name: mae
metrics.definition: mean over the scored pixel domain of |predicted_depth_reliability(p) - R_depth_sup(p)|

metrics.name: brier_score
metrics.definition: mean over the scored pixel domain of (predicted_depth_reliability(p) - R_depth_sup(p))^2

reporting_layers.name: reliability_vs_segmentation_risk
reporting_layers.question: does the predicted Depth reliability actually order pixels by real segmentation risk

metrics.name: reliability_error_monotonicity
metrics.definition: Spearman rank correlation between predicted Depth reliability and per-pixel segmentation error, computed separately per reporting group and per condition on the scored pixel domain

metrics.name: risk_coverage_curve
metrics.definition: risk(c) = mean per-pixel segmentation error over the top-c fraction of scored pixels when pixels are ordered by predicted Depth reliability descending, evaluated at the 20 fixed coverage points c = 0.05, 0.10, ..., 1.00

metrics.name: aurc
metrics.definition: area under the risk-coverage curve, trapezoidal integration over c in [0, 1] using the origin c = 0 plus the 20 fixed coverage points

reporting_layers.name: downstream_gain
reporting_layers.question: does reliability-conditioned use of Depth actually improve segmentation
reporting_layers.allowed_only_after: the B1 learned reliability-conditioned geometry adapter has been implemented, trained and evaluated under its own frozen protocol
metrics: mIoU in percentage points under the frozen A2 robustness conditions
paired location-group bootstrap 95% percentile interval of every reported segmentation delta
reporting_layers.statement: layers 1 and 2 can never answer the downstream question and can never be reported as a substitute for the primary robustness score

explicit_invalid.label: explicit-invalid
explicit_invalid.detectability: trivially detectable: this population is readable from depth_valid alone without any learned estimator

implicit_quality.label: implicit-quality
implicit_quality.detectability: not readable from depth_valid: these pixels stay nonzero, so recognising them requires learned quality evidence

reporting_groups.separation_reason: the explicit-invalid population is trivially identifiable through depth_valid, so a strong explicit-invalid reliability result must never be used to mask an implicit-quality recognition failure
reporting_groups.joint_number_policy: a single pooled number across both groups may only be reported in addition to the two separate group numbers, never instead of them

error_definition.pixel_error: 0 when the argmax over the MUSeg foreground class set of the aggregated FP32 pre-softmax logits equals the ground-truth label, otherwise 1
error_definition.class_set: identical to the frozen A2 mIoU report
error_definition.logit_policy: FP32 mean of pre-softmax logits over the 10 views
error_definition.padding_policy: pixels outside valid_mask are excluded from every reported statistic
error_definition.scored_pixel_domain: valid_mask(p), further restricted per reporting group exactly as declared in reporting_groups

sampling_units.pixel_unit: one pixel on the original image grid
sampling_units.aggregation_order: per-pixel statistic inside a view, then per image over the 10 views, then paired by location group

preregistered: the three reporting layers and their metric definitions
the explicit-invalid / implicit-quality group split and each group's scored pixel domain
the estimators and their bootstrap 95% percentile intervals
the sampling units (318 val-dev images, 196 location groups, 10 views)
reporting_rules.statement: this supplemental protocol preregisters metrics, groups, estimators and confidence intervals only. It defines no new success or failure threshold, no directional cut-off and no corrected significance family, and it can never replace or rescue the frozen A2 primary robustness gate.

readings_that_must_be_reported_descripti.reliability_error_monotonicity: Spearman rank correlation between predicted Depth reliability and per-pixel segmentation error, per reporting group and per condition, reported with its bootstrap 95% percentile interval
readings_that_must_be_reported_descripti.risk_coverage_curve: risk(c) at the fixed coverage points, reported per group and per condition
readings_that_must_be_reported_descripti.aurc: area under the risk-coverage curve, reported with its bootstrap 95% percentile interval and alongside the two reference predictors (a) constant reliability equal to the group mean and (b) depth_valid_post as a 0/1 reliability; the references are reported for context only and no relative-improvement threshold is applied
readings_that_must_be_reported_descripti.brier_score: Brier score against the constant predictor equal to the masked mean of R_depth_sup, reported for context only and without a relative-improvement threshold
readings_that_must_be_reported_descripti.mae: mean absolute error against R_depth_sup with its bootstrap 95% percentile interval

reporting_rules.multiplicity_policy: no multiplicity correction and no corrected significance family are preregistered; this protocol is descriptive and reports intervals as they are

abort_report_on: val sample count not equal to 318
sha256 mismatch against the locked A2 data identity
empty scored pixel domain for a declared reporting group
failure_handling.on_partial_failure: mark the affected metric as incomplete-not-reported and keep every other frozen metric; never silently drop, re-weight or replace a metric

The revision instruction fixed only the metric names, the three layers and the two reporting groups.

retained_as_computational_settings.interpretation: the bootstrap resample count is a precision setting, not a scientific threshold; alpha 0.05 exists only as the 95% interval level

no_new_gates_statement.what_would_be_needed_to_reintroduce_a_ga: an explicitly enumerated list of confirmatory hypotheses with a stated correction family and alpha, registered before results exist
